messages:
alex: Heads-up: a customer hit a surprise cost/soft-quota spiral because their embedding batches mixed 128d and 1024d vectors. They asked why some requests cost 10x others despite similar batch sizes.

maria: Oof. They don't see per-request units in Console today. We only show aggregate token counts.

sam: We compute an internal cost estimate during preflight for routing. We can expose it in headers and surface samples in Console. Concern: don't make it look like an invoice.

julian: Agreed. UX: show `estimated_units` + per-item avg and a small dims-bucket breakdown (e.g. 128:4,1024:1). That will immediately clarify mixed-dim penalty.

ingress-bot: Current preflight header proto: `X-Embed-Estimate-Units: 2300` and `X-Embed-Estimate-BREAKDOWN: tokens=9200;buckets=128:4,1024:1;pad=64`

maria: Console plan: behind a feature flag `console.embed_estimates_v1`. Add a request details panel with sample header parsing and an aggregated histogram on the route dashboard. Tooltip: "Estimated units: guidance for batching & model selection, not billing."

sam: Implementation notes: breakdown computation is O(n). For large batches we should compress into dims buckets server-side. Also add metrics: `ingress_embed_estimate_units_sum` and `ingress_embed_estimate_units_hist` with labels tenant_id, route, model, dims_bucket.

julian: Dashboard filter idea: let customers filter by dims_bucket to inspect which payload shapes drive units. Also highlight outliers (batch_size small but unit cost huge).

alex: Security check: any PII/KMS concerns with sending breakdowns to Console?

maria: Nothing sensitive in dims buckets, but we'll avoid sending example payloads. Only counts and computed unit numbers.

sam: Rollout: enable internally next week for Canary tenants, opt-in for external customers. Add logging when breakdown parse fails so DevEx can triage.

alex: Action items: Sam - PR to emit headers & Prom metrics. Maria - Console UI + flag + tooltip + sample query. Julian - docs snippet explaining dims buckets and common mistakes. I'll draft a customer FAQ. Timeline: canary in 7 days, beta in 2 weeks.

devex-bot: Snippet (pseudo):
```python
def preflight_estimate(batch):
    buckets = bucket_by_dims(batch)  # e.g. {128:4,1024:1}
    units = sum(estimate_item(d) for d in batch)
    return headers.update({
        'X-Embed-Estimate-Units': str(units),
        'X-Embed-Estimate-BREAKDOWN': f"tokens={tokens};buckets={','.join(f'{k}:{v}' for k,v in buckets.items())};pad={pad}"
    })
```

alex: Nice. Let's keep the header compact for customers and a richer JSON in internal debug logs. Thanks all.

julian: I'll draft the tooltip copy: "Estimated units — a runtime heuristic used for routing and batching guidance. Use dims hints, smaller quantized models, or split large vectors to reduce units."

maria: I'll add a small example graph: p50 units vs batch size and dims buckets.

alex: Done for now. Ping here if you hit edgecases. :thumbsup:
